title: A Unified First-Principles Theory of theta-Expectations from Deterministic Billiards
primary_blockers: The manuscript is far beyond normal article scope at 243 pages and is structurally closer to a monograph/program.

The central singular-billiard spectral-gap, Dolgopyat, moving-singularity response, and homogenization claims are stated as internally derived but the proof level is too schematic for a top mathematics submission.
The finite-response mechanical port appears too expressive and weakens the advertised first-principles claim.
The nonlinear expectation and probabilistic representation sections depend on strong downstream regularity/ellipticity conditions not reconciled with the derived degenerate HJB setting.
Local compile succeeds, but layout/log hygiene is not gate-clean.
